test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There are six persons, i.e. A, B, C, D, E and F sitting on a round table facing center, not necessarily in same order. D is not a neighbour of A or B. A is second to the left of B. B is a neighbour of E and F. Who is the second to the right of D?
solution:
Given: There are six persons, i.e. A, B, C, D, E and F sitting on a round table facing center, not necessarily in same order.

1) A is second to the left of B.

2) D is not a neighbour of A or B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/132ea29eb88384e8da33522b47b96a66ff08d8f6c81b4ff6b75ba020da9151cf.png] 

3) B is a neighbour of E and F.

And, C will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b52f06f8ff0095cff076ad2373374095ee3e55e4fe94d66ab7f07c94b5b02369.png] 

So, 'A' is the second to the right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
